title: 8 links that explain today's AI chip moves, including a 57%GlobalFoundries target. Which matchup are you taking?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Chips are at a crossroads before Nvidia reports. The average analyst  
target on GlobalFoundries sits 57% above the price, and today's  
head-to-heads pit Credo against Nvidia, Broadcom against Seagate,  
Marvell against Qualcomm and more. No spoilers on the winners. Today's  
overview of the chip matchups everyone is talking about is below —  
pick your side, then check the breakdown.  
  
Here is the rundown, drawn from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. GlobalFoundries (GFS)\*\* — The central target of $62 is the  
arithmetic mean of 15 recent, individually attributed analyst price  
targets reviewed for this analysis, not a single firm's forecast.  
Target, not a promise.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/globalfoundries-gfs-stock-can-it-achieve-the-57-move-to-62-39499/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/globalfoundries-gfs-stock-can-it-achieve-the-57-move-to-62-39499/)
